row.title: Judge the code-agent ladder by answers, not by runs
row.body: From 2026-11-23 every code-agent rung failed: the site's CF_DEPLOY_TOKEN has no Workers AI permission so /__internal/cf returned 401, and GitHub Models answered 200 OK text/plain. 20 of 21 executor-shelved items in 72 h died that way while clocks read green. Fix: ai/run goes through the site's AI binding; dispose no longer shelves an item for a dead ladder; ladderwatch --check is a live detector (fm-code-ladder-dead).

title: Judge the code-agent ladder by answers, not by runs
